review.mode: independent read-only composition review; no tests/build/device/source edits
review.conclusion: No actionable production composition regression found in the four conflict owners or traced origin/readiness handoffs. Combined execution remains unverified.

verified.sameWeakMap: viewport and nativePressTargets share one evidence record; attachment merges existing fields. Native targets are keyed per final node index in the array-owned map.
verified.assembly: stripNativePressTargets wraps attachRefs; viewport copy executes afterward on the exact final nodes array (snapshot-state.ts105-115).
verified.memoryClone: cloneSnapshot structuredClone once, then copies native targets and viewport to cloned.nodes; constructor/get/set/list share cloneSessionRecord.
verified.facade: both evidence families exported; readSnapshotViewportEvidence remains module-private.
verified.provider: presentIosSnapshotAcquisition preserves original acquisition viewport and publishes trusted viewport onlyreported; byte-identical to merged base.
verified.guard: await origin guard is first runInteractionPipelineStages action, before visibility rescue and readiness.
verified.freshGuard: guardPressReadiness.revalidate calls reObserveTarget→resolveInteractionTarget→selector/ref pipeline→awaited origin guard. AppError window-origin-unknown is propagated and disclosed:no.

testPlan.assessment: Extend existing screen-origin tests; this is necessary composition coverage, not a new test framework.
testPlan.forceReplacement: Put an actual numeric nativePressTarget descriptor on the raw action node before buildSnapshotState. Existing Group compaction then stripNativePressTargets must produce the final replacement array.
testPlan.unknown: Derived/missing cases must assert zero readPressReadiness calls as well as zero rescue/input, and preserve typed window-origin-unknown/dispatched:no after real memory-store cloning.
testPlan.reported: Use press selector and saved-ref routes with ready callback. Assert the callback receives exact numeric native descriptor/identity/globalrect and backend receives screen point591,335. Public nodes must not expose nativePressTarget.
testPlan.nativeRefCaveat: click with tapTarget takes the separate provider-native fast path and intentionally does not use readiness; retain its zero-input origin oracle but do not expect a readiness call there.
testPlan.helper: Existing createInteractionDevice helper currently does not accept/forward readPressReadiness; extend its test-only Pick/forwarder or use the existing readiness test setup. No production seam/export needed.
testPlan.lossControls: When heavy is authorized, remove/misorder viewport copy to prove unknown rejection detection; omit native-target clone copy or replace merged evidence to prove reported readiness binding detection.

limitations: Read-only source review only; no claim of combined execution, timing, or native proof.
Scope is rebase composition and its affected origin/readiness interactions; prior broad SDK reviews remain separate.

sourceAndControlScope: Review is read-only source assessment; focused/mutation executions are separate actual behavioral test controls, not live native/device proof.
